description.p: FastViz is a minimal, very fast photo and video browser. It opens large folders of photos and clips instantly, even on slow or external drives, and keeps a thumbnail cache so folders you have visited before show up at once.

ul.li: Folder tree and a thumbnail grid that stays smooth with tens of thousands of files
Home folders, every drive and your phone in the folder tree; drives mount when you open them
Fullscreen viewer with zoom, and the next and previous items preloaded
Video playback with hardware decoding
JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, HEIC/HEIF and AVIF photos, and nearly any video format
Sort by name, date, date taken, format, dimensions or size; shuffle; show only pictures or videos
Cut, copy, paste, rename and move to Trash with undo, working together with Files
Slideshows

screenshot.caption: Fullscreen viewer with the info overlay

ul.li: Thumbnails are saved from the very first launch (a new thumbnail cache could be switched off for the first session)
Photos opened from the file manager are sharp straight away in small folders
The metadata panel no longer pops up by itself when a photo opens
New screenshots

Camera RAW photos: Canon CR2 and CR3, Sony ARW, Nikon NEF, DNG, Fujifilm, Olympus, Panasonic, Pentax and more. Thumbnails use the camera's embedded preview; fullscreen shows it at once, then the developed RAW
The metadata panel in fullscreen also works for CR3 files
The folder tree starts collapsed to the start folder at every launch
Hardware-decoded video stays on the GPU under X11 too
Fixed a memory leak in the Open With dialog
Back and forward buttons in the header bar (Alt+Left and Alt+Right)
Open With… in the right-click menu, with a dark app chooser
Fullscreen: push the pointer to the right edge to see all of the photo's EXIF metadata
Dragging a thumbnail to another app shows a small icon, so the drop target stays visible
Thumbnail padding now sets the space between columns too, not only between rows
The folder tree lists Documents, Pictures and the other folders in Home, and every drive and phone, like Files; drives that aren't mounted yet mount when opened
If the folder FastViz opens at startup is on a drive that isn't mounted yet, the drive is mounted first
Larger app icon, closer in size to other apps in the taskbar
